description: Resolve a QIE ID such as yourname.qie to its QIE address on QIE mainnet (chain 1990). A bare label gets .qie appended. The server reads the QIE ID record stores (free QIE IDs first, then paid) whose source is published on the QIE explorer, and checks that each upgradeable proxy still points at the reviewed implementation. A name with no record returns status ok with address null. The address always comes from the chain. When the server has the QIE ID API configured, the result can also include otherChainAddresses (bitcoin, solana, tron, xrp records), each one only if the record store holds the same value on chain. QIE ID is not deployed on testnet (chain 1983), so lookups there return status unresolved. No address is guessed. This tool does not give price, APY, returns, yield, or investment advice and will decline such questions.

network.description: Pinned network. mainnet is chain 1990 and testnet is chain 1983. Defaults to mainnet. A raw chain ID or RPC URL is not accepted.
